errors.evidence: The description fails to describe the individual lines for the years 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023, which are represented by separate colored lines (light purple, dark purple, green, and light blue, respectively). The prompt explicitly asks for a description of each line.
The description omits the prominent annotation on the chart, which is a blue arrow pointing to the 2024 line with the text 'Aktueller Speicherstand in Deutschland bei ca. 37 %'.

The chart shows four blue squares representing the 'Speicherverpflichtung' (storage obligation) for Feb 1 (30%), Sep 1 (80%), Oct 1 (90%), and Nov 1 (95%). The description only mentions two dates and omits the points for September and November.

errors.text_span: Eine weitere farbige Linie stellt die Jahre 2020, 2021, 2022 und 2023 dar.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The years 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023 are not represented by a single line, but by four separate, distinctly colored lines.

errors.text_span: Der Startpunkt der Linie für 2024 liegt bei etwa 30 Prozent im Januar
errors.evidence: The dark blue line for 2024 starts at approximately 90% in January, not 30%. The value of ~37% mentioned in the chart annotation corresponds to a point around late March/early April.

The description of the 2024 line claims it 'steigt kontinuierlich' (rises continuously) from the start. However, the line clearly shows a decrease from January to a low point around late April before it starts to rise.

errors.evidence: The data for the 2025 line only exists for a short period in January. The description fabricates a trend for the rest of the year where no data is present in the chart.
